title: Accounts Receivable Explainer: The Advance Amount on a Booked Respite or Trial Stay
content:
The advance on a booked stay under the Respite and Short-Term Stay Agreement is the advance-nights charge plus every add-on and fee posted on the stay, less the receipts counted toward the advance, never less than zero, rounded half up to the cent once, on the final total.

## Elements of the advance

- **The advance nights** are the minimum stay of the stay type.
- **The advance-nights charge** is the advance nights times the nightly rate locked at booking.
- **Every add-on and fee posted on the stay** is the total of all add-on charges of every kind posted on the stay account together with any cancellation fee posted on it. Nightly charge segments are not add-ons or fees and are not part of this total.
- **The receipts counted toward the advance** are the payments posted on the stay less the returned payments posted on it.
- **The advance** is the advance-nights charge plus every add-on and fee posted on the stay, less the receipts counted; where that comes to less than zero the advance is zero. It is rounded half up to the cent once, on the final total.

## Worked statements (hypothetical stays)

**Statement 1.** A booked Assisted Living Respite Stay (Standard Care) is locked at 239.00 a night; its minimum stay is 7 nights. The stay account shows add-ons of 95.00 in total, one payment of 500.00 and no returned payment.

| Line | Figure |
|---|---|
| Advance-nights charge: 7 times 239.00 | 1,673.00 |
| Add-ons and fees posted | 95.00 |
| Receipts counted: 500.00 less nothing returned | 500.00 |
| Advance: 1,673.00 plus 95.00 less 500.00 | 1,268.00 |

**Statement 2.** A booked Independent Living Trial Stay locked at 145.00 with a minimum stay of 3 nights shows no add-ons and payments of 600.00. The advance-nights charge is 3 times 145.00, that is 435.00; less 600.00 that is below zero, so the advance is 0.00.

**Statement 3.** A booked stay shows payments of 1,000.00 and 400.00, of which the 400.00 payment was returned. The receipts counted are 1,400.00 less 400.00, that is 1,000.00.
